events.name: Grease Dance
events.description: The real Grease (1978) carnival finale with your faces in it: one of you crawls after the red heels on the grass, gets nudged away by a foot, then the two of you dance face to face through the crowd in black.

events.name: OIIA Spinning Cat Meme
events.description: Your cat or dog as the OIIA spinning cat: lying low on a plain white backdrop, it spins on the spot like a figurine on a turntable, then stops dead and stares straight at you.

events.name: Pedro Raccoon Dance Meme
events.description: Your cat or dog in the Pedro raccoon meme: seen from below in a round circle on black, bobbing to the beat and pawing at the lens while the whole view spins round and round.

events.name: Skull Cap
events.description: You pull a goofy face in a bright room, your hand covers the lens, and you're back in the dark with a black hood up over a shiny black skull cap and a slow, steady stare into the camera.
